QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] To Be Human
QuestInfo.0: You finally destroyed the Aspire facility, and so brought an end to Scion and its cruel ambitions. But now, with the dust settled, what does #bSpencer#k think about all that has happened? He should be near the Hideout, so find him and have a chat.
QuestInfo.2: #bAspire#k, the breakout tech firm that crossed many ethical boundaries in the development of its \n#bWondroid#k line of android companions, now lies in ruins. Let us never forget these surprisingly human souls and hope that the sadness they endured will serve as a lesson to future generations to treat all with care and respect.
